objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document within the system, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction) determining its level in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix for the document type used in the document name (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, updated upon each revision cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The calculated expiration date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas within the organization where the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person registered as the primary author responsible for creating the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with write access who can assist in document creation and editing.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) authorized to approve and release the document for distribution.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment defining which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons informed by email notification upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can view the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document's release process.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment, tracked independently but released with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly without formal review.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Switch indicating whether the additional information is released and published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changes to an existing released document, created by users with author rights without affecting the document's current content or version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled for implementation, completed).

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: The person who created the change proposal.

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of how the change proposal was addressed by the document author.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document's validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document, withdrawing it from circulation and archiving it with revocation of authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: The user who initiated the request for override.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it to an editable state for subsequent release.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: The user who initiated the request for reactivation (initiator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used for assigning read or change authorizations, distribution lists, and role-based access to documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Archive).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The category or role type of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and permissions for document management activities.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: The license role assigned to the user (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: The language in which the user accesses the system, affecting which translated document versions are displayed.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used as a basis for creating new documents with pre-configured structure and TAG-based metadata fields.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the document template.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The file format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature recorded by workflow participants during the release process, documenting approval at each step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the signature was provided (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company structure that can be linked to documents for context and filing purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and context.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the business process.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate organizational tenant in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the client.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a specific main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary content attached to a specific Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity needs to be checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to invalidate it.
A Request for Reactivation references a specific invalidated Document for re-validation.
A Document can be created based on a Document Template defined for its document type.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document can reference other Documents.
A Distribution List is maintained for a specific Document to control notification upon release.
A Distribution List assigns User Groups for notification and access.
A Distribution List can directly assign individual Users for notification.
A Document specifies visibility in one or more Clients in a multi-client system.
